name: Triumph of Saint Katherine

abilities.name: Acts of Faith
abilities.description: At the start of each phase, if you have not used an Act of Faith this phase, one unit from your army with this ability can use an Act of Faith. If it does, gain D3 Miracle dice.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Save
abilities.description: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Blessings of the Faithful
abilities.description: At the start of your Command phase, gain D6 Miracle dice instead of D3 if this model is on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Shield of Faith
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6" of this model have a 6+ invulnerable save (or improve their invulnerable save by 1 if it is already 6+).

abilities.name: Living Relic
abilities.description: Each time this model is selected as the target of an Act of Faith, you can change the result of one Act of Faith dice to any number.

abilities.name: Sacred Rites
abilities.description: Once per battle, in your Command phase, this model can perform a Sacred Rite. Select one of the following: grant all friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6" the Scouts 6" ability until the end of the turn, or add 1 to all Acts of Faith dice rolls until the start of your next Command phase.

constraints.description: The Triumph of Saint Katherine is an Epic Hero and cannot be included more than once in your army.

notes: The Triumph of Saint Katherine is a massive devotional processional carried by six Order Pronatus bearers. It does not have a Leader ability and cannot attach to other units.
